method: Whisper tiny.en re-transcription of final mixed MP4, compared with intended narration. ASR differences need interpretation; this is not proof of word-perfect audio.
transcript: Your Power BI semantic model can also be a source for a fabric data agent. Microsoft's documented setup starts by creating the agent and choosing its data sources. You can add up to five supported sources in one agent. Select the tables it should use. Give columns and tables descriptive names. Then ask a concrete question. For example, what were total sales in California in 2023? The agent can generate SQL, DAX, or KQL, depending on the data source. It uses your data access permissions, clear descriptions, and a clean model help it choose the right query. Before a real demo, check capacity prerequisites, permissions, and the generated query against a known answer.
